sourceRefs.finding: Generic action vocabulary now uses DirectedFlowVisual and exposes WebGlRunActionKinds.All; ResourceTransferVisual is removed.
Boundary options are configurable and validator now scans run id, initial scene ids/kinds/tags/symbols/links/layers, frame/stage metadata.
Generic domain driver contract, manifest, hash, metadata scrubber, and driver validator exist.
Domain leakage CI scans source/docs/tools/workflows with term registry and explicit allowlists.
Economy bridge implements EconomyWebGlRunDomainMappingDriver and maps ResourceTransferVisual to DirectedFlowVisual.
Economy-owned strict generic boundary terms include economy, ledger, market, buyer/seller, investor, elite, price, water, well.
Third canary scenario exists with grain/tools/credit/equity-share, exchange, contribution, claim issue, fee, policy, and obligation events.
Third canary has concentration, top share, trade volume, issue count, and elite capital dependency metrics/invariants.
Readiness report now has evidence records and bands, but evidence validator validates record structure rather than reading/hash-checking files.
Mutation layer still combines store resolution, transfers, severity/rejection policy, flow metadata, and store policy resolution.
Economy boundary script enforces reference boundaries, line-count gates, determinism, and example-specific term scans.
